notes: Identity independently verified from supplied full article text: title Children’s and adults’ judgments of equitable resource distributions; authors Koleen McCrink, Paul Bloom and Laurie R. Santos; DOI 10.1111/j.1467-7687.2009.00859.x. Primary journal report with methods, results, discussion and references, pp. 37–45. Journal header prints Developmental Science 13:1 (2010); supplied reference uses 2009 (also printed copyright year). No PDF supplied. Target selected by explicit five-year-olds-versus-adults developmental comparison in absolutely equal trials, not row order or numerical matching. The canonical text renders the chi-square symbol as v2; the Results section explicitly identifies chi-square goodness-of-fit tests. Printed p = .003 accompanies the selected test; the sentence mentions Bonferroni-corrected alpha values for multiple comparisons, not an author-explicit correction of the p-value. Within-group five-year-old comparison with chance (5.5, p = .06) and adult comparison with chance (48, p < .0001) are distinct tests and were not substituted for the direct between-age comparison. n and all replication/success fields are unassigned placeholders; no analytic N derived or extracted.
